description: Execute the full design pipeline (compose -> validate -> render -> codegen) in a single call. It forwards draft, build, or release generation validation without downgrade and always discloses the applied validationReceipt plus target resolution provenance. The code step carries the versioned artifact without flattening, including exact dependencies and required consumer-supplied domain actions. Defaults to compact render mode (token CSS omitted). Supports optional validation/render skipping, an optional static screen and built-scope contrast check (options.checkA11y; unresolved pairs remain unmeasured), and schema persistence via save parameter. Returns schemaRefCreatedAt/schemaRefExpiresAt (default TTL: 30 minutes); use save to persist the schema. Release receipts report evidenceVerification:file-verified-not-re-executed. Local JSON evidence files are opened and SHA-256, passed status and artifact binding are verified; evidence is not re-executed. contentHash names the evidence file-byte digest. OODS-V162 reports missing files or envelopes; OODS-V163 reports invalid JSON, byte hash, status or artifact binding. Portable React/Vue generation uses an assembly-time readiness attestation bound to shipped package bytes and emits real artifacts without source or test files. Missing or tampered readiness evidence returns OODS-N015 without an artifact. Host repository generation retains direct readiness checks.

artifactContentHash.description: Exact generated artifact hash inspected by this evidence.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the local JSON evidence file bytes. The file must contain status: passed and this artifactContentHash.

reference.description: Local JSON evidence file, absolute or relative to the server working directory. Opened during release validation.

inputSchema.description: Execute the full design pipeline (compose -> validate -> render -> codegen) in a single call. A workflow schema generates a runnable React or Vue application with navigation, local store and deterministic sample data.

actionMappings.description: Stage1 BridgeSummary action_mappings, flat verb-keyed entries. See docs/integration/stage1-oods-contract.md §2c.

intent.description: A short intent sentence, matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables (a sentence that matches no layout keyword becomes a low-confidence dashboard). Prefer object and context.

layout.description: Layout template to use. 'landing' is a content/marketing page (hero + sections + CTA), not bound to a data object. 'auto' infers the best template from intent keywords.

object.description: Object name from the OODS registry (e.g., Subscription, User).

checkA11y.description: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against current built tokens for every registered brand and theme, including team brands. With a UiSchema, renders through the shared HTML renderer and checks document language/title, one main landmark, unique IDs, ARIA reference targets, control names/labels, image alternatives, chart SVG name/description, and heading names/order. Reports unresolved inherited surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha compositing and OS colours as unmeasured. Does not check browser-computed colour/layout, keyboard/focus interaction or screen-reader behavior; no complete WCAG conformance claim.

compact.description: When true (default), omit token CSS from render output and return tokenCssRef instead. Reduces response size by ~40%.

framework.description: Alias: target framework. Overridden by top-level framework if both provided.

renderApply.description: Render with apply=true to include HTML output (default true).

styling.description: Alias: styling strategy. Overridden by top-level styling if both provided.

typescript.description: Alias: enable TypeScript output in code generation.

fieldGroups.description: Number of field groups for form layout.

metricColumns.description: Number of metric columns for dashboard layout.

tabCount.description: Number of tabs for detail layout.

tabLabels.description: Custom tab labels for detail layout.

profile.description: Validation profile forwarded unchanged to code.generate, including its workflow-state contract gate. build is the default blocking gate of static checks; the static gate does not install or run the generated application.

releaseEvidence.description: Hash-bound release evidence forwarded unchanged to code.generate.

save.description: Optional schema save config. String for name-only, or { name, tags } for full control.

name: pipeline
